title: 🔝 App
body:
It’s a must have. Setting it up might be a little tricky if you’re not familiar with shortcuts, but tutorial are already in-app to help dealing with it. 

I wanted to ask two things though: personally, i like the intervention more than the blocking, so I was wondering if it were possible to have per-app personalised intervention, just like the blocking schedule. 

The other thing is: I personally like to schedule everything I have to do during the day in Structured, but some tasks don’t need an intervention, so a function to ignore certain tasks would be useful, in my opinion. 

Nevertheless, great app, I really mean it, best money I have ever spent on an app. 
Keep up the good work 👍🏼
